title: deckstack DSF1 binary stream frame (frame plane)
description: B2/S14: the frame plane is binary, not NDJSON. Layout on the stream socket (stream.sock / pipe): 4-byte magic "DSF1" | u32 LE meta_len | UTF-8 JSON meta (this schema) | u64 LE payload_len | payload bytes. The meta object is validated against this schema; the payload is NOT JSON. Control messages on the stream socket (stream-credit/stream-ack/stream-nack) are NDJSON lines prefixed by magic "DSctl\n" so the two framings are distinguishable on one socket. See docs/contracts/ipc.md §2 and docs/contracts/streaming.md.

target.description: Unified target vocabulary (S6): keys = 480x272 panel (cmd 0x35), key:N = 72x72 key N (cmd 0x36), dial = 240x240 (cmd 0x45).

seq.description: Producer-side monotonically increasing sequence per target.

format.description: Wire format; the daemon always re-encodes to baseline JPEG, standard Huffman, 4:4:4 (upstream/PROTOCOL.md:87-96). Optimized-Huffman JPEG input is rejected with E_FORMAT.

max_payload_bytes.description: Wire cap 16 MB (MAX_BODY precedent, upstream engine/plugins.rs:266). Enforced by the daemon before reading the payload.
